title: Photo Video Vault - Hidely
summary: Hide photos, videos & files securely with Fingerprint Lock vault.
description:
Photo & Video Vault – Hidely helps you safely store and protect your personal photos, videos, audio files, and documents in one private vault.

On first launch, you set a secure lock, and all your personal content remains protected inside a private space that only you can access.

It includes a built-in Private Browser that allows you to browse privately, with browsing history stored locally and controlled by you.
Hide private media, secure important files, and maintain your privacy on your device with a simple, reliable, and easy-to-use vault app.
🔐 Advanced Protection Features
📸 Hide Photos & Videos
 Store your personal photos and videos in a protected vault. Only you can access your media, keeping it safe from unwanted eyes.
🎵 Secure Audio Files
 Lock voice recordings, music, and other audio files in a dedicated vault designed for your personal use.
🗂️ File Vault
 Keep important documents, downloads, and files organized and hidden in one safe place. Quick access whenever you need it.
🌐 Built-in Private Browser
Browse the web using the built-in private browser. Your browsing activity stays inside the app, with full control to view or clear browsing history anytime to keep your data private
📷 Intruder Alerts & Selfies
 Detect any unauthorized attempts to access your vault. The app can automatically capture intruder photos, adding an extra layer of protection.
♻️ Trash Bin & Easy Recovery
 Accidentally deleted photos, videos, audio files, or documents? Restore them quickly from the Trash Bin without hassle.
🔐 Multiple Lock Methods
 Secure your vault with PIN, Pattern, or Password. Choose the method that works perfectly for you.

🛡️ Why Choose This App?
 Photo & Video Vault - Hidely lets you hide and organize your personal media and files effortlessly. Its user-friendly interface and advanced vault system make it perfect for anyone who wants full control over their personal content.

🎯 Key Benefits:
 • Safely hide and organize photos, videos, audio, and files.
 • Protect important documents and downloads
 • Surf online safely with built-in browser
 • Get instant notifications for unauthorized access.
 • Restore accidentally deleted items easily
 • Experience a clean, simple, and user-friendly interface.

Protect your personal content like never before! Photo & Video Vault - Hidely makes it easy to manage, hide, and protect your photos, videos, audio files, and documents—all in one secure app. Download now and keep your memories, media, and files protected just for you.
